Karmāśuklākṛṣṇaṃ yoginastrividhamitareṣām /IV.7/
Karma–aśukla-akṛṣṇaṃ yoginas tri-vidham itareṣām /IV.7/

« L'acte du yogin est non-blanc-non-noir ; pour les autres, il est de trois sortes. »

Yataḥ / Karma–aśukla-akṛṣṇaṃ yoginas trividham itareṣām / Catuṣpāt
1775 khalv iyaṃ karma-
jātayaḥ / Kṛṣṇā śukla-kṛṣṇā śuklā–aśukla-akṛṣṇā ca–iti / Tatra kṛṣṇā durātmanām / Śukla-
kṛṣṇā bahiḥ-sādhana-sādhyā tatra para-pīḍā-anugraha-dvāreṇa–eva karma-āśaya-pracayaḥ /
Śuklā tapaḥ-svādhyāya-dhyānavatām / Sā hi kevale manasy āyatatvād
1776 bahiḥ-sādhana-
adhīnā
1777 na parān pīḍayitvā bhavati / Aśukla-akṛṣṇ
